name: prisma-mcp
description: PrismaUI_F4 2.2.0 modern/legacy/VR API, release metadata, guides, search, and plugin scaffolding for MCP-compatible assistants.
long_description: Gives an MCP client verified access to the PrismaUI_F4 2.2.0 release contract, byte-pinned modern, V1-V12 compatibility, and VR SDK headers, modern feature-table introspection, current developer guides, and modern-first plugin scaffolding.

github_token.title: GitHub token (optional)
github_token.description: Raises GitHub API rate limits for public Fallout-4-Prisma-UI-Framework lookups. Matrix access is not required.

tools.name: get_framework_release
tools.description: Get the pinned PrismaUI_F4 2.2.0 release identity, desktop/controller runtime boundaries, release artifacts, modern feature list, and verified SDK provenance.

tools.name: list_modern_features
tools.description: List every released modern feature table with IDs, versions, members, typedefs, and signatures.

tools.name: get_modern_feature
tools.description: Get one modern feature table such as Controller, Localization, GameThread, View, Render, Input, or Menu.

tools.name: get_modern_header
tools.description: Get the exact released PrismaUI_F4_Modern_API.h after verifying its pinned Git blob.

tools.name: get_header
tools.description: Get the exact released PrismaUI_F4_API.h V1-V12 compatibility header after verifying its pinned Git blob.

tools.name: get_vr_header
tools.description: Get the exact released PrismaUI_F4VR_API.h after verifying its pinned Git blob.

tools.name: list_api_methods
tools.description: List documented V1-V12 compatibility API methods, optionally filtered by interface version.

tools.name: get_api_method
tools.description: Get full docs for one numbered V1-V12 compatibility API method.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search legacy method docs, current developer guides, and verified modern/VR SDK contracts.

tools.name: get_guide
tools.description: Get the full text of a current PrismaUI developer or release guide.

tools.name: scaffold_plugin
tools.description: Write a consumer plugin project using modern feature tables by default, with an explicit legacy mode.
